ns0:svg.aria-label: Majin Buu Saga P10: Majin Buu's Smooch
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Majin Buu's Smooch

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
POWER: Discard all Drills in play. Each player may
then search their discard pile and Life Deck for up
to the number of Drills they discarded, different
from those they discarded, and put them into play.
